issues.description: Method visibility mismatch for singFarmSongVerse(Animal): the problem statement (problem_statement.md) explicitly instructs students to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public, but the template implementation declares the method as private and the provided solution also implements it as private. This inconsistency can confuse students and may cause automated tests or graders that expect a public helper to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent. Either update the problem statement to request a private helper (which matches the UML, template, and solution), or change the template and solution method signatures to public if tests rely on accessing this helper. Preferation: if automated tests access the helper, change the method signature in the template (and solution example) to public; otherwise update the problem text to instruct that the helper may be private and ensure tests access it only via public singFarmSong().
